summary: Selected h=90 champion: lgbm_A_no_anc (LightGBM, feature set A, raw units target, inner-split early stopping). On fold-3 non-zero val rows (4 rows, excl Dec29 closure): val_mae=19.856 vs floor=45.0. Beats floor by 25.144 units. CAUTION: only 4 evaluation rows — result is high-variance. State updated with this champion. Multi-fold verification included in code but results are on 4 non-zero rows only for primary fold. Full multi-fold will be re-evaluated in end_model before final champion declaration.

handoff.read_this_first: h=90 lgbm_A_no_anc beats floor on 4 non-zero fold-3 val rows (MAE=19.856 vs floor=45.0). High variance — end_model MUST re-evaluate multi-fold before declaring champion. Config: n_leaves=16, lr=0.05, n_trees=68, inner-split ES (last 20% of train).

durable_rules.rule: h=90 champion candidate lgbm_A_no_anc: n_leaves=16, lr=0.05, n_trees=68, max_depth=4, reg_alpha=2.0, reg_lambda=20.0, min_child_samples=max(5, n_train_inner//50). Train filter: fold-3 train, is_covid_lockdown_period==0. Inner split: last 20% of train rows for ES.
durable_rules.why: These hyperparameters were found via fold-3 grid search with inner early stopping. Pinned because the stop point cannot be re-derived once val rows are included in refit.
durable_rules.cost_if_broken: Refit uses wrong tree count — under or over-fits.

methodological_cautions.caution: h=90 fold-3 non-zero val has only 4 rows. MAE=19.856 on 4 rows has a standard error ~25 units. The floor=45.0 on those same 4 rows is also noisy. The multi-fold pooled result is the only reliable estimate.
methodological_cautions.why: Dec29 closure removes one of 5 val rows. 4 rows means each point has a 25% weight on the MAE.
methodological_cautions.cost_if_ignored: Deploying a model that appears to beat floor by 25 units but actually beats it by much less (or not at all) on a larger evaluation set.
